title: DNA binding contributes to dominant-negative effects of a catalytically inactive RecQ4-family helicase
authors: Robert H. Simmons; Faith E. McDevitt; Alexandra Hurlock; Michael E. Kumcu; Matthew L. Bochman
one_liner_zh: 该文通过遗传抑制筛选和生化结构分析，研究催化失活的RecQ4解旋酶Hrq1的DNA结合能力如何导致显性负效应，涉及蛋白-DNA互作机制，但未采用AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA体系。
abstract: DNA inter-strand crosslinks (ICLs) are highly cytotoxic lesions that require coordinated processing for repair. The RecQ4-family helicase Hrq1 promotes ICL repair in Saccharomyces cerevisiae , yet the mechanistic basis of its function remains unclear. Notably, the catalytically inactive hrq1-K318A allele confers greater sensitivity to ICL-inducing agents than deletion of HRQ1 , suggesting a dominant-negative effect. To define the basis of this phenotype, we performed a genetic suppressor screen combined with biochemical and structural analyses. Spontaneous suppressors of hrq1-K318A sensitivity were overwhelmingly intragenic second-site mutations, many of which are predicted to destabilize the protein or impair its ability to bind DNA. In all cases, these mutations alleviated the dominant-negative repair defect. Biochemical characterization of representative mutants, including a rationally designed DNA-binding mutant, demonstrated that disruption of DNA binding suppresses hrq1-K318A toxicity even when protein stability is retained. These findings support a model in which DNA engagement by a catalytically inactive RecQ4-family helicase contributes to dominant-negative interference with DNA repair. More broadly, this work provides insight into how incomplete loss-of-function alleles of human RECQL4 may disrupt genome maintenance pathways. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT
abstract_zh: DNA链间交联（ICLs）是高度细胞毒性的损伤，需要协调加工才能修复。RecQ4家族解旋酶Hrq1促进酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中的ICL修复，但其功能的机制基础仍不清楚。值得注意的是，催化失活的hrq1-K318A等位基因对ICL诱导剂的敏感性高于HRQ1缺失，表明存在显性负效应。为明确该表型的基础，我们进行了遗传抑制子筛选，并结合生化和结构分析。hrq1-K318A敏感性的自发抑制子绝大多数是基因内第二位点突变，其中许多被预测会 destabilize 蛋白质或损害其结合DNA的能力。在所有情况下，这些突变都缓解了显性负修复缺陷。对代表性突变体（包括合理设计的DNA结合突变体）的生化表征表明，即使蛋白质稳定性得以保留，破坏DNA结合也能抑制hrq1-K318A的毒性。这些发现支持一个模型，即催化失活的RecQ4家族解旋酶与DNA的结合有助于对DNA修复的显性负干扰。更广泛地，这项工作为人类RECQL4的不完全功能丧失等位基因如何破坏基因组维持途径提供了见解。图形摘要
